facts.text: I am looking for new yoga classes to try.
I want online yoga classes or studios that focus on restorative yoga or yin yoga.
I have been attending a restorative yoga class at a studio near my house.
I love the restorative yoga class I attend near my house.
The instructor of my restorative yoga class is Rachel.
Rachel's restorative yoga class helps me feel more centered and focused.
I think the calming atmosphere Rachel creates in class helps me feel comfortable.
I feel comfortable because of Rachel's gentle adjustments.
Since I started attending Rachel's class, I have noticed significant improvement in my flexibility.
My flexibility improvement since starting Rachel's class is especially in my hamstrings.
My flexibility improvement since starting Rachel's class is especially in my hip flexors.
I have been attending Rachel's class for about 3 months.
I do a 10-minute morning flow at home every day.
My 10-minute morning flow focuses on sun salutations and gentle stretches.
My daily morning flow helps me feel more centered and focused for the rest of the day.
My daily morning flow increases my energy levels.
My daily morning flow makes me feel more motivated to tackle my daily tasks.
I have not been focusing on meditation or breathwork specifically.
I try to incorporate more mindfulness into my daily activities.
I try to be more present in my daily tasks.
I focus on the sensations in my body rather than getting caught up in thoughts.
